zh: 週三（9/30）是九月與第三季的最後一天，美股上演盤中大逆轉：標普 500 一度大漲近 0.7%，收盤卻轉跌 0.25%、收在 7,651.54；道瓊跌 443.87 點、以 0.86% 收在 50,906.05；那斯達克反而逆勢收高 0.24% 到 26,861.06。整個九月標普跌 0.5%、道瓊重挫 4.3%，那斯達克漲 1.9%；第三季標普漲 2%、那斯達克漲 2.5%，道瓊則下跌 2.7%。指數內部的分化比指數本身更值得看：科技撐盤、傳統大型股承壓。
en: Wednesday, Sept. 30, the last day of September and the third quarter, brought a late reversal: the S&P 500 was up nearly 0.7% intraday but closed down 0.25% at 7,651.54. The Dow fell 443.87 points, or 0.86%, to 50,906.05, while the Nasdaq Composite bucked the trend, rising 0.24% to 26,861.06. For September the S&P lost 0.5%, the Dow dropped 4.3% and the Nasdaq gained 1.9%; for the quarter the S&P rose 2%, the Nasdaq 2.5% and the Dow fell 2.7%. The split inside the indexes matters more than the headline: tech held up while old-line large caps sagged.

stocks.n: 追蹤道瓊的 ETF，指數單日 -0.86%、九月 -4.3%，是三大指數中最弱的
追蹤那斯達克 100，母指數逆勢 +0.24%，九月 +1.9%
追蹤標普 500，盤中最多漲近 0.7%、收盤反轉為 -0.25%

zh: 8 月 PCE 物價指數的數字其實不差：整體年增 3.4%（前月 3.7%，預期持平在 3.7%），剔除食品與能源的核心 PCE 年增 3.0%（前月 3.3%），都低於預期。但債市沒買單：十年期殖利率收盤仍上升約 4 個基點、來到 5.298%，盤中一度突破 5.3%；三十年期升近 5 個基點到 5.642%。原因是同一天 ADP 顯示 9 月民間新增 9 萬個工作（預期 6.8 萬、8 月下修為 3.6 萬），加上亞特蘭大聯準會對第三季 GDP 的估計偏熱——市場讀到的是「通膨在降、但成長沒降」，長期利率於是繼續往上。
en: August PCE inflation came in cooler: headline 3.4% year over year (prior 3.7%, consensus 3.7%) and core 3.0% (prior 3.3%). Bonds did not cheer: the 10-year yield still rose about 4 basis points to 5.298%, topping 5.3% intraday, and the 30-year added nearly 5 basis points to 5.642%. ADP showed 90,000 private jobs added in September versus 68,000 expected, with August revised down to 36,000, and the Atlanta Fed's Q3 GDP estimate runs hot. The read-through was that inflation is easing but growth is not, so long rates kept climbing.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，三十年期殖利率升到 5.642% 代表它價格承壓
七到十年期美債 ETF，十年期殖利率 5.298%、為 2007 年以來高檔區
區域銀行 ETF，是對殖利率曲線與資金成本最敏感的族群之一

zh: 指數沒大跌，底下卻不太健康。CNBC 的盤中統計顯示，紐約證交所的 52 週新低家數（262）遠多於新高（23），那斯達克也是新低 294 對新高 84；成交量只有 30 日均量的約 52%（紐約證交所）與 69%（那斯達克），代表上漲缺乏追價。個股兩極：Meta 九月漲近 29%，市場對它的首個消費者 AI 代理 Muse 買單；麥當勞九月跌逾 11%，年初至今跌近 24%，管理層坦言通膨與客流持平。資金集中在少數主題、其他地方在被拋售，這就是「指數看起來還好」的另一面。
en: The indexes held, but the tape underneath was shaky. CNBC's late-day tally showed 262 new 52-week lows against just 23 highs on the NYSE, and 294 lows versus 84 highs on the Nasdaq, with volume at roughly 52% (NYSE) and 69% (Nasdaq) of the 30-day average. Single stocks split hard: Meta gained nearly 29% in September on the reception of its first consumer AI agent, Muse, while McDonald's fell more than 11% for the month and nearly 24% year to date as its CEO cited inflation and flat traffic. Money is crowding into a few themes while the rest is being sold.

stocks.n: 九月漲約 28.8%，起因是首個消費者 AI 代理 Muse 獲市場好評
九月跌逾 11%、今年累計跌近 24%，管理層指通膨壓抑客流
標普 500 等權重 ETF，與市值加權的 SPY 對照可看出廣度是否轉弱

zh: 亞歐盤給了相對溫和的背景。日經 225 收漲 1.94% 到 66,753.72，南韓綜合指數小跌 0.48% 到 6,838.04；歐洲 Stoxx 600 早盤漲約 0.7%。中國官方 9 月製造業 PMI 升到 50.1（8 月 49.8），結束連續兩個月的萎縮，主要由設備與高科技製造帶動。商品端，布蘭特原油九月累計漲逾 14%、在每桶 104 美元附近，美國原油漲逾 6%、在 91 美元之上，起因是 9 月 10 日沙烏地東西向輸油管遭無人機攻擊後一度關閉；目前 Yanbu 港裝載量已回升，但供應風險溢價還沒完全退場。
en: Overseas markets offered a milder backdrop. Japan's Nikkei 225 closed up 1.94% at 66,753.72, South Korea's Kospi slipped 0.48% to 6,838.04, and the Stoxx 600 rose about 0.7% early. China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 50.1 from 49.8, ending two months of contraction on equipment and high-tech output. In commodities, Brent gained more than 14% in September to near $104 a barrel and U.S. crude rose more than 6% to above $91 after a drone attack closed Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline on Sept. 10; Yanbu loadings have recovered, but the supply risk premium has not fully drained.

stocks.n: 日本 ETF，日經 225 當日收漲 1.94%
南韓 ETF，南韓綜合指數當日 -0.48%
原油 ETF，布蘭特九月漲逾 14%、美國原油漲逾 6%

zh: 美光（MU）週三盤後交出近乎誇張的成績：2026 會計年度第四季營收 542.3 億美元、年增 379%，調整後每股盈餘 33.42 美元（預期約 31.83 美元），調整後毛利率 87.0%；DRAM 營收 398 億美元、占 73%。第一季財測營收 615 億美元（上下 15 億），高於市場預期的約 568 億，每股盈餘 38.15 美元（預期 36.02 美元）。但股價盤後仍小跌約 1.2%、盤前約 1,080 美元：原因是管理層宣布 2027 會計年度資本支出調高，上半年約 250 億美元，其中多數是為 2028 年底之後的無塵室而建。市場的問題從「需求夠不夠」變成「蓋這麼多產能會不會有一天過剩」。
en: Micron (MU) delivered a near-absurd quarter after Wednesday's close: fiscal Q4 revenue of $54.23 billion, up 379%, adjusted EPS of $33.42 versus about $31.83 expected, and an adjusted gross margin of 87.0%. DRAM revenue was $39.8 billion, 73% of sales. Q1 guidance of $61.5 billion plus or minus $1.5 billion topped the roughly $56.8 billion consensus, with EPS of $38.15 versus $36.02. Yet the stock slipped about 1.2% after hours and traded near $1,080 premarket, because management said it will raise fiscal 2027 capex, about $25 billion in the first half, mostly cleanroom construction for late 2028 and beyond. The question shifted from whether demand is enough to whether this much capacity eventually overshoots.

stocks.n: 財報後盤後約 -1.2%，營收年增 379%、毛利率 87.0%，但資本支出調高蓋過財測
半導體設備股，美光擴建無塵室與設備支出是它的需求端

zh: 耐吉（NKE）預計今天（10/1）公布 2027 會計年度第一季財報。市場共識約為營收 114 億美元（年減約 2.7%）、每股盈餘 0.44 美元（年減約 10%）；股價今年累計已跌約 43%、近一年跌約 49%，市值約 540 億美元。看點不在這季數字本身，而在三件事：大中華區的庫存清理要拖到什麼時候、關稅與促銷對毛利率的侵蝕、以及重整計畫「Win Now」有沒有出現拐點的跡象。耐吉是消費者信心走弱與關稅雙重壓力下，最直接的檢驗。
en: Nike (NKE) is due to report fiscal 2027 first-quarter results on Oct. 1. Consensus is roughly $11.4 billion in revenue (down about 2.7%) and EPS of $0.44 (down about 10%); the stock is down about 43% year to date and 49% over one year, for a market value near $54 billion. The focus is less the quarter itself than three questions: how long the Greater China inventory cleanup lasts, how tariffs and promotions erode gross margin, and whether the 'Win Now' restructuring shows an inflection. Nike is the cleanest test of weak consumer confidence meeting tariffs.

stocks.n: 今日公布財報，共識 EPS 約 0.44 美元、營收約 114 億美元，今年累計跌約 43%

zh: 蛋商卡爾曼食品（Cal-Maine，CALM）週三公布 2027 會計年度第一季（截至 8 月 29 日）：營收 5.396 億美元、年減 41.5%（去年同期 9.226 億美元），低於預期的約 5.75 億；GAAP 每股虧損 1.26 美元，遠大於 FactSet 預期的虧損 0.59 美元。這是蛋價從去年的歷史高點回落、供給恢復後的典型景氣循環結果。據報導股價在財報後仍有上漲，反映市場早已把低點反映在價格上。這張卡的價值是判讀：高利潤的商品循環股，營收減四成往往不是壞消息的尾端，而是波段的中段。
en: Egg producer Cal-Maine (CALM) reported fiscal 2027 first-quarter results (quarter ended Aug. 29) on Wednesday: revenue of $539.6 million, down 41.5% from $922.6 million, below the roughly $575 million expected, and a GAAP loss of $1.26 per share versus the FactSet-expected loss of $0.59. It is the classic cycle result as egg prices retreat from last year's records and supply recovers. Shares reportedly rose after the report, suggesting the trough was already priced. The lesson: for high-margin commodity-cycle names, a 40% revenue drop is often the middle of the swing, not the end.

stocks.n: 最大蛋商，單季營收年減 41.5%、每股虧損 1.26 美元，劣於預期的 0.59 美元

zh: PCE 數字出爐後，CME FedWatch 顯示 10 月升息一碼的機率從前一天約 51% 降到約 35%，但年底前再升一次仍是市場共識，未來十二個月三到四次升息的定價也沒有消失。紐約聯邦準備銀行總裁威廉斯週二說聯準會「可以有耐心」，高盛首席經濟學家哈祖斯因此把第二次升息從 10 月推到 12 月，並認為之後可能就不需要再升了——這個看法明顯比市場共識溫和。目前聯邦基金利率目標區間是 3.75% 到 4%，聯準會 9 月的預測是年底升到約 4.1%。重點是：數據轉好了，但決策者要的是連續幾份數據，不是一份。
en: After the PCE print, CME FedWatch put the odds of an October quarter-point hike near 35%, down from about 51% a day earlier, but another hike by year-end remains the market's base case and three to four hikes over the next 12 months are still priced. New York Fed President John Williams said Tuesday the Fed can afford to be patient, and Goldman's Jan Hatzius pushed the second hike from October to December and sees a strong chance the Fed concludes more hikes are unnecessary, a view well out of consensus. The funds rate target range is 3.75% to 4%, and the Fed's September projections point to about 4.1% by year-end. Better data is welcome, but policymakers want a run of prints, not one.

stocks.n: 短天期美債 ETF，對聯準會年底前路徑的定價最敏感
高盛，其經濟學家預期 12 月升息後停止，與市場共識有落差

zh: 本週最大的數據是週五（10/2）早上 8:30 的 9 月非農就業報告，市場預期新增 8.4 萬個工作，大約只有 8 月的一半。前一天 ADP 先給了個意外：9 月民間新增 9 萬個，高於預期的 6.8 萬，但 8 月被下修到 3.6 萬。這個組合有點尷尬——數字不差，卻是建立在被下修的基期之上。對市場來說，非農的關鍵不只在總數，而在薪資成長：薪資若偏強，就會把 PCE 轉好帶來的升息降溫整個沖掉，所以「數字好」和「股價好」今天不一定同方向。
en: The week's biggest print is Friday's (Oct. 2) 8:30 a.m. September payrolls report, with economists expecting 84,000 new jobs, about half of August's gain. ADP surprised a day earlier with 90,000 private jobs versus 68,000 expected, but August was revised down to 36,000. The mix is awkward: a decent number built on a lower base. For markets, the key is not only the headline but wage growth; firm wages would erase the easing in hike odds that cooler PCE delivered, so a good number and a good stock market may not point the same way.

stocks.n: 金融類股 ETF，利率路徑與放款需求的直接反映
區域銀行 ETF，對利率預期變動與放款需求最敏感

zh: 今天（10/1）美東上午 10 點公布 9 月 ISM 製造業指數，市場預期從 8 月的 54.6 小升到 55.0，是連續站在 50 榮枯線之上。為什麼值得看：高於 50 代表製造業在擴張，而擴張加上高油價，正好是目前聯準會最怕的組合——成長沒降、成本在升。要特別注意兩個子項：價格支付指數（顯示成本壓力是否外溢）與新訂單（顯示需求是否真有基礎）。如果新訂單強、價格也強，市場會把它讀成「升息還沒結束」的證據；如果新訂單強、價格溫和，才是皆大歡喜的版本。
en: The September ISM manufacturing index is due at 10 a.m. ET today (Oct. 1), expected to edge up to 55.0 from 54.6, staying above the 50 expansion line. It matters because expansion plus high oil is precisely the mix the Fed fears: growth that has not slowed while costs rise. Watch two sub-indexes: prices paid, to see whether cost pressure is spreading, and new orders, to see whether demand has real footing. Strong orders with strong prices would be read as evidence the hiking cycle is not over; strong orders with tame prices is the happy version.

stocks.n: 工業類股 ETF，製造業景氣的直接代表
重型機械大廠，新訂單與資本支出循環的指標

zh: 國防板塊今天有兩個訊號，而且方向相反。第一，美國海軍把 F/A-XX 第六代艦載戰鬥機合約交給波音（BA），金額超過 200 億美元、取代現役 F/A-18 超級大黃蜂，波音盤前漲約 3%；落選的諾斯洛普格魯曼（NOC）盤前跌約 3.5%。第二，五角大廈宣布要設立「自主作戰司令部」（Autowarcom），重心在無人機、機器人與更快的採購流程，預計 2027 年 10 月才會運作。同一個預算，錢往「有人戰機的大合約」與「低成本無人系統」兩個方向分流，這對主承包商與新創的估值是不同的故事。
en: Defense gave two signals pointing in opposite directions. First, the U.S. Navy awarded Boeing (BA) the F/A-XX sixth-generation fighter contract, worth more than $20 billion, to replace the F/A-18 Super Hornet; Boeing rose about 3% premarket while rival Northrop Grumman (NOC) fell about 3.5%. Second, the Pentagon announced an Autonomous Warfare Command (Autowarcom) focused on drones, robotics and faster procurement, expected to be operational by October 2027. The same budget is splitting between big crewed-aircraft awards and low-cost autonomous systems, which tell different valuation stories for primes and upstarts.

stocks.n: 贏得 F/A-XX 海軍第六代戰機合約（逾 200 億美元），盤前漲約 3%
據報同樣競標但落選，盤前跌約 3.5%
美國航太國防 ETF，兩家主承包商的相對表現會反映在它的權重結構

zh: 公用事業今天出現一個罕見畫面：傳統上最防禦的板塊，正被當成 AI 成長股在買。愛力安能源（Alliant Energy，LNT）盤前大漲約 7.6%，理由是資料中心用電需求激增與多年資本支出計畫。公司資料顯示，已簽約的資料中心負載約 3 吉瓦（4 個專案），到 2031 年相當於 2025 年尖峰負載增加逾 50%，2025 到 2031 年電力銷售約年均成長 11%，支撐 134 億美元以上的資本支出規劃。判讀要點：在殖利率 5.3% 的環境裡，一般公用事業股息的吸引力被債券壓低，能獨立於利率之外走強的，是有明確「成長合約」的那一小群。
en: Utilities showed a rare picture: the most defensive sector is being bought as an AI growth story. Alliant Energy (LNT) jumped about 7.6% premarket on surging data-center power demand and a multiyear capital plan. Company materials show about 3 GW of contracted data-center load across four projects, more than a 50% increase over 2025 peak load by 2031, roughly 11% electric sales growth from 2025 to 2031, and a capital plan of more than $13.4 billion. With the 10-year at 5.3%, plain-vanilla utility dividends lose appeal to bonds; the ones that can rise independently of rates are the few with explicit growth contracts.

stocks.n: 盤前約 +7.6%，已簽約資料中心負載約 3 吉瓦、資本支出規劃逾 134 億美元
公用事業類股 ETF，殖利率走高對它的估值是逆風

zh: 煉油股最近被一個政策風險壓著：美國政府正在討論限制柴油出口。9 月 23 日川普表態支持後，瓦萊羅（VLO）當天跌 4.1%、馬拉松石油（MPC）跌約 3%，隔天又各自下跌；傑富瑞同時把兩家評等降到「持有」。能源部長萊特則在探詢煉油商是否願意「自願性」限制出口，而不是直接禁。背景是這兩家的每股盈餘已是去年同期的近四倍，禁令會讓美國原油相對布蘭特的折價擴大、迫使煉油商壓低產能。這是政策風險而不是需求風險，判讀時要分開：盈餘很強、但利潤的上限掌握在華府手上。
en: Refiners are under a policy overhang: Washington is weighing limits on diesel exports. After President Trump voiced support on Sept. 23, Valero (VLO) fell 4.1% and Marathon Petroleum (MPC) about 3% that day and slid again the next; Jefferies cut both to hold. Energy Secretary Chris Wright is sounding out refiners on a voluntary restriction rather than an outright ban. Earnings per share at both are nearly four times a year ago, and a ban would widen the U.S. crude discount to Brent and force refiners to cut runs. It is policy risk rather than demand risk: earnings are strong, but the ceiling on profits sits in Washington.

stocks.n: 9/23 單日跌 4.1%，傑富瑞降評至持有，每股盈餘近四倍於去年同期
9/23 單日跌約 3%，同樣被傑富瑞降評至持有

zh: 小型股現在的壓力在資金面。羅素 2000 ETF（IWM）上週淨流出 33 億美元，是今年第二大的單週贖回、也是近九年第三大；羅素 2000 自 8 月中旬高點回落約 7.3%，標普 500 已連續五週跑贏小型股，若再多一週，將是八年來最長的連續跑贏。直接原因看起來是十年期殖利率從約 4.6% 爬到約 5.3%：小型股借的多是浮動利率，利率每升一碼，利息就是直接吃掉獲利。反向觀點是：期中選舉年的 10 月，歷史上季節性偏多，大筆贖回有時恰是賣壓接近尾聲的訊號——但這只是機率，不是保證。
en: Small caps are under pressure from flows. The iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) saw $3.3 billion of outflows last week, its second-largest weekly withdrawal of 2026 and third-largest in nine years. The Russell 2000 is about 7.3% below its mid-August high, and the S&P 500 has outperformed small caps for five straight weeks; one more would be the longest streak in eight years. The 10-year yield rising from about 4.6% to 5.3% is the proximate cause: small caps carry more floating-rate debt, so each hike flows straight through interest costs. The counterpoint is that October of a midterm year is seasonally strong and big redemptions can mark late-stage selling, but that is odds, not a guarantee.

stocks.n: 上週淨流出 33 億美元，為今年第二大單週贖回
標普小型 600 ETF，品質篩選較嚴，常用來對照羅素 2000 的壓力是否同步

zh: 一個容易被忽略的判讀知識：今年的「小型股」比你以為的大。6 月羅素重組後，區分大型（羅素 1000）與小型（羅素 2000）的市值門檻大幅上調 24%、創下紀錄的 57 億美元；羅素 2000 第二季漲了 21.5%。意思是，指數裡的公司平均比過去更大、更成熟，而真正的微型股（市值幾億美元）在指數裡的權重在下降。下次看到「小型股落後」時，要先問：落後的是哪一層？是 57 億美元邊緣的公司，還是市值低於 10 億美元、沒有分析師追蹤的那一群？它們的資金來源、利率敏感度與流動性完全不同。
en: A piece of reading knowledge easily missed: this year's 'small cap' is bigger than you think. After the June Russell reconstitution, the market-cap breakpoint between large (Russell 1000) and small (Russell 2000) jumped 24% to a record $5.7 billion, and the Russell 2000 rose 21.5% in the second quarter. The average company in the index is larger and more mature than before, while true micro-caps weigh less. Next time you read that small caps lag, ask which layer: companies near the $5.7 billion edge, or the sub-$1 billion names with no analyst coverage; their funding, rate sensitivity and liquidity are completely different.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，6 月重組後與大型股的市值門檻提高到 57 億美元
微型股 ETF，市值最小的那一層，與 IWM 的壓力來源不同

zh: 五角大廈公布自主作戰司令部（Autowarcom）計畫後，一籃子無人機相關小型股隔夜上漲：Ondas（ONDS，市值約 44 億美元）、AeroVironment（AVAV，約 74 億）、Kratos（KTOS，約 82 億）、Red Cat（RCAT，約 10 億）與 Unusual Machines（UMAC）。要冷靜讀：這個司令部預計要到 2027 年 10 月才會運作，預算與合約的落地還有至少一年以上；概念先漲、訂單後到，是這類主題的典型節奏，也意味著中間可能出現很深的回檔。分辨誰是真有合約的公司、誰只是題材，才是這類標的的核心功課。
en: A basket of drone small caps rose overnight after the Pentagon unveiled its Autonomous Warfare Command (Autowarcom) plan: Ondas (ONDS, about $4.4 billion market value), AeroVironment (AVAV, about $7.4 billion), Kratos (KTOS, about $8.2 billion), Red Cat (RCAT, about $1 billion) and Unusual Machines (UMAC). Read it calmly: the command is expected to be operational only by October 2027, so budgets and contracts are at least a year away. Concept first, orders later is the typical rhythm and implies sharp pullbacks in between. Separating firms with real contracts from pure themes is the core homework.

stocks.n: 無人機大廠，市值約 74 億美元，隔夜隨自主作戰司令部消息上漲
小型無人機公司，市值約 10 億美元，題材敏感度高
自主戰鬥機（Valkyrie）供應商，市值約 82 億美元

zh: 週三稀土概念股集體上漲：MP Materials（MP）漲 6.4% 收 48.36 美元，USA Rare Earth（USAR）漲 3% 到 14.44 美元；在格陵蘭擁有礦區專案的 Critical Metals 盤中最高飆 43%。起因是美國、丹麥與格陵蘭簽署的防衛協議，讓市場期待稀土開採的利多。但 Motley Fool 的核查指出：MP 與 USAR 在格陵蘭都沒有資產，不太可能直接受惠。這是典型的主題性外溢：真正有曝險的公司暴漲、只是同產業的公司跟著漲，後者的漲幅更容易回吐。
en: Rare-earth stocks rose together Wednesday: MP Materials (MP) gained 6.4% to $48.36 and USA Rare Earth (USAR) rose 3% to $14.44, while Critical Metals, which has a Greenland mining project, spiked as much as 43%. The trigger was a U.S.-Denmark-Greenland defense agreement that lifted hopes for rare-earth extraction. But a Motley Fool check noted that neither MP nor USAR has assets in Greenland and is unlikely to benefit directly. It is classic thematic spillover: the firm with real exposure spikes, same-industry peers ride along, and the peers' gains are the easiest to give back.

stocks.n: 稀土生產商，週三 +6.4% 收 48.36 美元，但在格陵蘭沒有資產
稀土磁材公司，週三 +3% 到 14.44 美元，同樣與格陵蘭無直接關聯

zh: 兩個跌到低點的消費股，剛好示範怎麼讀「換人」與「內部人賣出」。美泰兒（MAT）週三宣布由現任董事 Roger Lynch 接任執行長兼董事長、最晚 11 月 2 日上任，股價盤中跌逾 2%、創 52 週新低 12.53 美元。Medifast（MED）則是董事 Daniel Chard 在 9 月 28、29 日各賣出約 9,545 與 9,544 股，均價約 11.98 與 11.73 美元，股價約 11.5 美元、近一年跌 15%。MED 的賣出是依 Form 144 的獎勵股票計畫出售，這類例行賣出的資訊量遠低於自費公開市場買進；而 MAT 的換帥則把問題從「業績」拉到「策略」，下一個驗證點是新任執行長上任後的第一次指引。
en: Two consumer names at lows show how to read a CEO change and insider selling. Mattel (MAT) said Wednesday that director Roger Lynch will become CEO and chairman by Nov. 2; the stock fell more than 2% to a 52-week low of $12.53. At Medifast (MED), director Daniel Chard sold about 9,545 and 9,544 shares on Sept. 28 and 29 at averages near $11.98 and $11.73; the stock is near $11.5, down 15% over a year. Chard's sales are planned disposals of stock-award lots under Form 144, far less informative than open-market buying with one's own cash; Mattel's change moves the question from performance to strategy, with the next test being the new CEO's first guidance.

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 10 月初 Allied Paving 交割、12/2 前後 Q3 財報
zh: 這家公司做什麼：Cardinal Infrastructure Group（CDNL）是基礎建設工程承包商，2025 年 12 月上市。為什麼被忽視：上市不到一年，又在 8 月 11 日因毛利率目標下修，三個交易日內從 60.00 美元跌到 34.66 美元（單日 -36.2%），之後被多家原告律師事務所宣布調查，把它貼上「雷」的標籤。什麼正在改變：第二季營收 2.269 億美元（年增 114%），積壓訂單 8.66 億美元（年增 35%），全年營收指引從 6.8 億上調到 8.8 億至 9 億美元；調整後 EBITDA 率 12.4%，全年目標下修到 16% 至 18%。8 月 14 日，創辦人兼執行長、財務長、營運長與四位董事合計以均價約 38.54 美元自費買進約 854 萬美元，其中三位是首次直接買進。10 月初將完成約 1.2 億美元的 Allied Paving 收購（約 5.5 倍 EBITDA、被收購標的利潤率約 20.3%）。風險：律師事務所調查若轉為正式訴訟、分包與設備租賃成本若持續壓縮毛利、市場已對這支股票形成高成長預期。資料以 8 月底的整理為主，現價請自行確認。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: Cardinal Infrastructure Group (CDNL) is an infrastructure construction contractor that listed in December 2025. Why neglected: under a year as a public company, and after a margin-target cut on Aug. 11 it fell from $60.00 to $34.66 in three sessions (-36.2% in a day), then drew plaintiff-firm investigation notices. What is changing: Q2 revenue was $226.9 million (+114%), backlog $866 million (+35%), full-year revenue guidance rose to $880-900 million from $680 million, while adjusted EBITDA margin was 12.4% and the full-year target fell to 16-18%. On Aug. 14 the founder-CEO, CFO, COO and four directors bought about $8.54 million at a blended $38.54, three for the first time. The roughly $120 million Allied Paving deal (about 5.5x EBITDA, target margin ~20.3%) is due to close in early October. Risks: investigations turning into suits, subcontract and rental costs squeezing margin, and high growth expectations. Figures are mostly from an Aug. 24 write-up; check the current price. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 Q3 財報的毛利率是否回升
zh: 這家公司做什麼：Centuri Holdings（CTRI）為北美天然氣與電力公用事業提供基礎設施服務，客戶是受管制的公用事業公司。為什麼被忽視：市值約 20 億美元，近一年股價約 -11%，且最新一季毛利率被燃料成本壓縮，市場關注度偏低。什麼正在改變：9 月 18 日董事 Dustin Demaria 以 19.27 美元自費買進 5,200 股（約 10 萬美元），直接持股增加 67%，價位貼近 52 週低點 19.03 美元；第二季營收創紀錄的 9.62 億美元（年增 33%），毛利 6,910 萬美元（去年同期 6,780 萬），公司卻同時上調了 2026 全年指引。9 月 30 日股價約 19.93 美元。風險：營收成長但毛利沒跟上，燃料價格（與伊朗戰事相關）若持續高檔，利潤率恢復會被延後；近 12 個月淨利僅約 2,890 萬美元、獲利厚度薄；單一董事 10 萬美元的買進訊號強度有限。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: Centuri Holdings (CTRI) provides infrastructure services to regulated gas and electric utilities in North America. Why neglected: a market value near $2.0 billion, a stock about 11% lower over a year, and a latest quarter where gross margin was squeezed by fuel costs. What is changing: on Sept. 18 director Dustin Demaria bought 5,200 shares at $19.27 (about $100,000), lifting his direct stake 67%, near the 52-week low of $19.03; Q2 revenue was a record $962 million (+33%) and gross profit $69.1 million versus $67.8 million, yet the company raised 2026 guidance. The stock was about $19.93 on Sept. 30. Risks: revenue is growing but gross profit is not, high fuel costs tied to the Iran war could delay margin recovery, trailing net income is only about $28.9 million, and one director's $100,000 purchase is a limited signal. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 首批獨立財報與指數納入公告
zh: 這家公司做什麼：Vylor（VYLR）是 Corteva 分拆出來的種子事業，今天（10/1）起在紐約證交所以 VYLR 正式交易，Corteva 股東每持有 1 股可獲配 1 股 Vylor。為什麼被忽視：分拆股第一天通常沒有分析師覆蓋，母公司的股東也未必想持有種子事業（收到後賣出的壓力），灰盤期從 9 月 25 日到 9 月 30 日以 VYLR WI 交易。什麼正在改變：種子業務從與農化事業綁在一起，變成獨立上市，將能單獨分配資本與設定獲利目標，市場也會第一次給它獨立估值。風險：本摘要沒有取得財務數字，一切要以 Form 10 為準；分拆股前幾週的賣壓與波動很大；指數納入與法人持股結構尚未穩定。這張卡是追蹤清單，不是已驗證的拐點。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: Vylor (VYLR) is the seed business spun out of Corteva; regular-way NYSE trading under VYLR begins today (Oct. 1), with Corteva holders receiving one Vylor share for each Corteva share. Why neglected: spin-offs typically start with no analyst coverage, and parent shareholders may not want a seed business (receive-and-sell pressure); when-issued trading ran Sept. 25-30 as VYLR WI. What is changing: the seed unit moves from sharing a company with crop protection to listing on its own, able to allocate capital and set targets separately and to be valued on its own. Risks: this summary has no financial figures, so rely on the Form 10; first-weeks selling and volatility are large; index inclusion and holder base are unsettled. This card is a watch item, not a verified inflection. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

母公司 Corteva，分拆後剩下農化事業，兩家的相對表現是觀察重點

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 10 月下旬 Q3 財報與淨息差
zh: 這家公司做什麼：First Financial Corporation（THFF）是印第安納州的區域銀行控股公司，市值約 5.2 億美元。為什麼被忽視：市值小、位在中西部，在殖利率走高的時候，區域銀行整體被視為資金成本的受害者，連帶被一起忽略。什麼正在改變：第二季淨利 2,274 萬美元，高於去年同期的 1,859 萬美元（約 +22%），本益比約 10.5 倍；高階主管年初有自費買進；Paul Nungester 將在 2027 年 1 月前接任關鍵職位，是領導層交接的明確時間點。風險：估值折價是 Simply Wall St 的模型估算而非事實；區域銀行的存款成本與商用不動產曝險未在此摘要中查證；利率若再走高，淨息差壓力可能抵消獲利成長。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: First Financial Corporation (THFF) is an Indiana regional bank holding company with a market value near $520 million. Why neglected: small and Midwestern, and with yields rising, regional banks as a group are treated as victims of funding costs and overlooked together. What is changing: Q2 net income was $22.74 million versus $18.59 million a year earlier (about +22%), at roughly 10.5x earnings; executives bought shares early in the year; and Paul Nungester takes over key roles by January 2027, a clear leadership handoff date. Risks: the valuation discount is a Simply Wall St model estimate, not fact; deposit costs and commercial real estate exposure are not checked here; further rate rises could erase earnings growth through margin pressure. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: 印第安納州區域銀行，Q2 淨利 2,274 萬美元（約 +22%），本益比約 10.5 倍

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 Q3 財報的淨息差與信用成本
zh: 這家公司做什麼：Commercial Bancgroup（CBK）是一家區域銀行，市值約 13.5 億美元。為什麼被忽視：同樣被「區域銀行 = 利率受害者」的標籤帶過，在大型銀行搶走分析師視野的情況下，更少人細看。什麼正在改變：第二季淨利息收入 2,152 萬美元（去年同期 2,006 萬）、淨利 1,022 萬美元（去年同期 890 萬，約 +15%），本益比約 11.1 倍，內部人近期有買進；預估盈餘年增約 6.8%。風險：增速溫和、並非高成長故事；預估與估值折價均為第三方模型；利率與信用循環若轉壞，銀行盈餘對放款損失很敏感。與上一張同屬區域銀行，兩張請當成同一個主題的對照，不要當成兩個獨立機會。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: Commercial Bancgroup (CBK) is a regional bank with a market value near $1.35 billion. Why neglected: it carries the same 'regional bank equals rate victim' label and gets little scrutiny while large banks dominate analyst attention. What is changing: Q2 net interest income was $21.52 million versus $20.06 million, net income $10.22 million versus $8.9 million (about +15%), at roughly 11.1x earnings, with recent insider buying and forecast earnings growth of about 6.8% a year. Risks: growth is modest, not a high-growth story; the forecasts and valuation discount are third-party models; a worsening rate or credit cycle makes bank earnings sensitive to loan losses. Like the card above it is a regional bank, so treat the two as one theme, not two independent ideas. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 10 月底 Q3 財報的積壓訂單與毛利
zh: 這家公司做什麼：Orion Group Holdings（ORN）做海事工程（港口、碼頭、疏浚）與混凝土工程，雷達池內已有紀錄，今天回鍋更新。為什麼被忽視：市值小、營收毛利薄（市銷率約 0.4 倍），第二季又低於市場預期、財報後股價下跌，GAAP 淨損 410 萬美元、營收 2.219 億美元。什麼正在改變：6 月底積壓訂單 7.22 億美元，高於去年底的 6.4 億，其中海事 5.54 億、混凝土 1.68 億；第二季新增訂單約 2.77 億美元（訂單出貨比 1.25 倍）；混凝土事業營收成長逾 30%、調整後 EBITDA 成長 45%，管理層說可投標的案件管線約 270 億美元。Simply Wall St 的篩選也列出它有內部人買進。風險：獲利仍是虧損或接近損益兩平，積壓訂單要轉成毛利而不只是營收；估值折價是第三方模型估算。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: Orion Group Holdings (ORN) does marine construction (ports, docks, dredging) and concrete work; it is already in the radar pool and is revisited today. Why neglected: small, thin-margin (price-to-sales about 0.4x), and the second quarter missed estimates with shares falling afterward, a GAAP net loss of $4.1 million on $221.9 million of revenue. What is changing: backlog at June 30 was $722 million versus $640 million at year-end, with $554 million marine and $168 million concrete; Q2 awards were about $277 million (book-to-bill 1.25x); the concrete business grew revenue more than 30% and adjusted EBITDA 45%; management cites a bid pipeline near $27 billion. A Simply Wall St screen also flags insider buying. Risks: earnings are still a loss or near breakeven and backlog must turn into margin, not just revenue; the valuation discount is a third-party model estimate. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: 海事與混凝土工程，6 月底積壓訂單 7.22 億美元（去年底 6.4 億），Q2 淨損 410 萬美元

zh: Nayax（NYAX，無人販賣機與自助付款平台）執行長兼共同創辦人兼董事長 Yair Nechmad 9 月 29 日買進 19,000 股，估計約 85.1 萬美元。他過去六個月在公開市場一共買了 8 次、合計 151,446 股、約 671.5 萬美元，一次都沒賣。但同期內部人整體是 12 次買、45 次賣——其他高階主管（含財務長、營運、法務等）多數是賣方。讀法：創辦人一個人在持續自費加碼，團隊其餘人則在例行賣出；前者代表長期信念，後者可能只是股票獎勵的稅務賣出，兩者不矛盾，但也不能把這筆當成整個管理層的共識。
en: At Nayax (NYAX, an unattended-retail and payments platform), CEO, co-founder and chairman Yair Nechmad bought 19,000 shares on Sept. 29 for an estimated $851,000. Over six months he made eight open-market purchases totaling 151,446 shares, about $6.7 million, with no sales. But across all insiders the tally is 12 buys and 45 sells, with most other executives, including the CFO, operations and legal heads, on the sell side. Read it this way: the founder alone keeps adding with his own money while the rest of the team sells routinely, possibly tax-driven award sales. The two do not conflict, but this purchase is not a management consensus.

stocks.n: 執行長 9/29 買進 19,000 股（約 85 萬美元），六個月累計自費買約 671 萬美元

zh: H.B. Fuller（FUL，工業黏著劑製造商）近六個月有 8 次內部人買進、1 次賣出，最新一波是執行長 Celeste Beeks Mastin 買進 5,170 股（約 29.5 萬美元），再加上多位董事各買約 10 萬美元：Daniel Florness 9 月 28 日買 2,030 股（約 100,160 美元）、Srilata Zaheer 2,040 股、Charles Lauber 2,005 股、Teresa Trangsrud 2,042 股、Thomas Handley 2,000 股。注意這個形狀：五位董事買進的金額幾乎一模一樣，都在 10 萬美元上下。這很像董事會共同的持股政策或事先協調，而不是各自獨立的判斷，資訊量比表面看起來低；有意思的是，同期執行副總 Nathan Weaver 賣了約 59.3 萬美元。
en: H.B. Fuller (FUL, an industrial adhesives maker) shows eight insider buys and one sale in six months. The latest wave is CEO Celeste Beeks Mastin buying 5,170 shares (about $295,000) plus several directors buying about $100,000 each: Daniel Florness 2,030 shares (about $100,160) on Sept. 28, Srilata Zaheer 2,040, Charles Lauber 2,005, Teresa Trangsrud 2,042 and Thomas Handley 2,000. Note the shape: five directors bought almost identical dollar amounts near $100,000, which looks like a board-wide ownership policy or coordination rather than independent judgment, so the signal is weaker than it appears. Over the same period executive VP Nathan Weaver sold about $593,000.

stocks.n: 近六個月 8 買 1 賣，五位董事各買約 10 萬美元、金額幾乎一致

zh: 生技公司 ADARX Pharmaceuticals（ADRX）出現一筆大額申報：SR One Capital Management 在 9 月 28 日買進 592,593 股，估計約 1,007 萬美元（每股約 17 美元）。近六個月這個持股人共 3 次買進、合計 160 萬股、約 2,720 萬美元，六次公開市場交易全部是買、沒有賣。注意身分：SR One 是創投型的大股東，不是管理層，所以它代表的是機構資金的判斷與對特定臨床資產的信心，而不是公司內部對業務的了解。對生技股來說，大股東在小型股上持續加碼，通常意味著對下一個臨床節點的押注；但臨床結果是二元的，這類部位的風險也是二元的。
en: At biotech ADARX Pharmaceuticals (ADRX), SR One Capital Management bought 592,593 shares on Sept. 28 for an estimated $10.07 million, about $17 a share. Over six months the holder has made three buys totaling 1.6 million shares, about $27.2 million, and all six open-market trades were purchases with no sales. Note who it is: SR One is a venture-style large holder, not management, so it reflects an institutional view on specific clinical assets rather than operating knowledge from inside the company. In biotech, a large holder repeatedly adding to a small cap is usually a bet on the next clinical milestone, but clinical outcomes are binary, and so is the risk.

stocks.n: SR One Capital 9/28 買進 592,593 股（約 1,007 萬美元），六個月累計約 2,720 萬美元

zh: 參議院共和黨資深議員 Mitch McConnell 在 9 月 23 日揭露的 STOCK Act 申報中，新增一筆富國銀行（WFC）的買進。這份摘要沒有取得金額區間與交易日，所以只能列出事實：有人用真錢買進了一家大型銀行。這筆部位的結構所代表的假設，值得拿來對照當下的環境：十年期殖利率在 5.3%、聯準會處在升息週期，市場對銀行的疑問是淨息差與信用成本孰輕孰重。要注意的是，申報書不會寫動機，也無法判斷是否為既有部位的再投資；而且申報日距交易日最長可相隔 45 天，你今天讀到的，是一個多週前的世界裡做的決定。
en: Sen. Mitch McConnell's STOCK Act disclosure on Sept. 23 added a purchase of Wells Fargo (WFC). This summary did not obtain the amount range or trade date, so only the facts can be stated: someone put real money into a large bank. What the position implies is worth comparing with the current setting: the 10-year at 5.3% and the Fed in a hiking cycle, where the market's question on banks is whether net interest margin or credit costs matter more. Note that filings do not state motives, nor whether it is a reinvestment of an existing position, and the filing can lag the trade by up to 45 days, so today's reader sees a decision made in an earlier world.

stocks.n: 大型銀行，McConnell 在 9/23 揭露的申報中新增買進

zh: 眾議員 Byron Donalds 在 9 月 16 日揭露的申報裡，同一份文件同時有三件事：賣出 Howmet Aerospace（HWM）、買進 Netflix（NFLX）、賣出 Parker-Hannifin（PH）。判讀重點是，這份申報沒有單一主題可以讀：賣掉兩檔工業與航太供應鏈、買進一檔串流媒體，更像是一般的資產調整而不是押注某個故事。這正是這個頻道要持續提醒的事：不是每份申報都有 thesis，不是每個名字都有新聞度，而硬把一組買賣講成故事，是最常見的過度解讀。金額只有區間、申報有 45 天延遲，再加上很多是配偶或信託帳戶執行，你拿到的只是模糊的輪廓。
en: In Rep. Byron Donalds's disclosure of Sept. 16, one filing contains three items: a sale of Howmet Aerospace (HWM), a purchase of Netflix (NFLX) and a sale of Parker-Hannifin (PH). The point is that there is no single theme to read: selling two industrial and aerospace supply-chain names while buying one streaming company looks more like routine rebalancing than a bet on a story. That is exactly what this channel keeps reminding: not every filing has a thesis, not every name is newsworthy, and forcing a story on a set of trades is the most common over-reading. Amounts are only ranges, filings lag by up to 45 days, and many trades run through spouse or trust accounts, so you get a blurry outline.

zh: 接下來幾個交易日由兩份數據主導。今天（10/1）上午 10 點的 ISM 製造業指數，市場預期 55.0（前值 54.6）；明天（10/2）早上 8:30 是 9 月非農就業報告，市場預期新增 8.4 萬個工作、約只有 8 月的一半，此外還有失業率、平均時薪與工廠訂單。兩份數據的組合很關鍵：若製造業強、非農也強，市場會把它讀成升息路徑沒有結束；若兩者都轉弱，則會觸發「成長放緩」的擔憂，而殖利率可能反而下降。10 月 FOMC 升息機率目前約 35%，這兩天的數據是它的主要變數。
en: Two data points dominate the next few sessions. Today's (Oct. 1) 10 a.m. ISM manufacturing index is expected at 55.0 (prior 54.6); tomorrow's (Oct. 2) 8:30 a.m. September payrolls report is expected at 84,000 jobs, about half of August's gain, along with the unemployment rate, average hourly earnings and factory orders. The pair matters: strong manufacturing plus strong payrolls would read as a hiking path that is not over, while weakness in both would trigger growth worries and could actually lower yields. The odds of an October hike are about 35%, and these two days are the main swing factor.

zh: 財報與公司事件方面，今天有三件事。第一，耐吉（NKE）公布 2027 會計年度第一季，共識每股盈餘約 0.44 美元。第二，Vylor（VYLR）從 Corteva 分拆後今天正式交易，是未來幾週觀察分拆股賣壓與定價的樣本。第三，Cardinal Infrastructure（CDNL）預計 10 月初完成 Allied Paving 的收購。更往後看，百事公司（PEP）預計 10 月 8 日、達美航空（DAL）預計 10 月 9 日公布財報，它們通常被視為第三季財報季前的消費與旅遊先行指標；真正的財報季要等到 10 月中旬，由大型銀行揭幕。
en: On earnings and corporate events, three things today. First, Nike (NKE) reports fiscal 2027 first-quarter results, consensus EPS about $0.44. Second, Vylor (VYLR) begins trading after its spin-off from Corteva, a sample for watching spin-off selling pressure and pricing in coming weeks. Third, Cardinal Infrastructure (CDNL) expects to close its Allied Paving acquisition in early October. Further out, PepsiCo (PEP) is expected to report Oct. 8 and Delta Air Lines (DAL) Oct. 9, usually seen as early consumer and travel gauges before the third-quarter season, which truly opens in mid-October with the large banks.

zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：同一天出現了兩個「好消息被吞掉」的例子。第一，8 月核心 PCE 降到 3.0%、低於預期的 3.3%，聯準會 10 月升息機率從 51% 降到 35%，但十年期殖利率仍漲到 5.298%、道瓊跌 0.86%。第二，美光營收年增 379%、財測大幅高於預期，盤後股價卻因為資本支出上調而小跌。兩者共同的主線是：市場現在更在意「代價」而不是「成績」——利率是成長的代價，資本支出是產能的代價。這種時候，同樣的好數據可以讓股價上漲或下跌，取決於它是被解讀為「減輕壓力」還是「證明壓力還在」。明天的非農會是下一個測試。
en: The thing most worth noticing today: two cases of good news being swallowed on the same day. First, August core PCE fell to 3.0% versus 3.3% expected and October hike odds dropped from 51% to 35%, yet the 10-year yield still rose to 5.298% and the Dow fell 0.86%. Second, Micron's revenue grew 379% with guidance far above consensus, but the stock slipped after hours on higher capex. The common thread: the market now cares more about the price than the score, rates being the price of growth and capex the price of capacity. At such times the same good data can lift or sink a stock depending on whether it reads as relief or as proof the pressure remains. Tomorrow's payrolls are the next test.

stocks.n: 營收年增 379%、財測優於預期，但資本支出上調讓盤後小跌
